title: To Whom It May Concern Letter / Student Document Request
description: Use this guide when an enrolled or continuing student needs the official UAEU continuing-student documents service for a letter or student document request.
verificationNote: The public UAEU service URL points to the continuing-student documents service. Manual verification is still required for the exact post-login portal menu path, the exact To Whom It May Concern or certificate option label, required form fields, any fee or processing-time text, delivery options, submit button wording, and final confirmation/reference wording.

steps.title: Open the official UAEU service page
steps.instruction: Start from the UAEU continuing-student documents service page.
steps.note: This is the only current service URL found in the repository for this guide; manually recheck it if UAEU changes its services page.

steps.title: Sign in through the official UAEU portal
steps.instruction: Use your UAEU account only on the official portal when the service redirects you to sign in.
steps.note: Manual verification needed: the exact sign-in screen, redirect wording, and first post-login page label.

steps.title: Find the continuing-student documents area
steps.instruction: After sign-in, follow the official portal wording for continuing-student documents or student document requests.
steps.note: Manual verification needed: the exact menu names and navigation path shown after login.

steps.title: Select the needed document type
steps.instruction: Choose the To Whom It May Concern, certificate, or letter option only if that wording appears in the official portal.
steps.note: Manual verification needed: the exact current option label for this document type.

steps.title: Complete and review the official form
steps.instruction: Enter only the details requested by the portal and review the information before submitting.
steps.note: Manual verification needed: required fields, fees, processing time, language choices, delivery choices, and submit button wording.

steps.title: Save the official confirmation
steps.instruction: After submitting on the official portal, keep the confirmation or reference details if the portal provides them.
steps.note: Manual verification needed: final confirmation text and reference-number format.
